From 3adbbd2295ad138ab95404d0ffc6bfc1b8f9f1e4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Herbert Xu <herbert@gondor.apana.org.au>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2020 15:42:09 +1000
Subject: [PATCH] hwrng: cctrng - Add dependency on HAS_IOMEM

The cctrng doesn't compile without HAS_IOMEM so we should depend
on it.

Reported-by: kbuild test robot <lkp@intel.com>
Fixes: a583ed310bb6 ("hwrng: cctrng - introduce Arm CryptoCell driver")
Signed-off-by: Herbert Xu <herbert@gondor.apana.org.au>
Acked-by: Hadar Gat <hadar.gat@arm.com>
Signed-off-by: Herbert Xu <herbert@gondor.apana.org.au>

diff --git a/drivers/char/hw_random/Kconfig b/drivers/char/hw_random/Kconfig
index 848f26f78dc1..0c99735df694 100644
--- a/drivers/char/hw_random/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/char/hw_random/Kconfig
@@ -476,6 +476,7 @@ config HW_RANDOM_KEYSTONE
 
 config HW_RANDOM_CCTRNG
 	tristate "Arm CryptoCell True Random Number Generator support"
+	depends on HAS_IOMEM
 	default HW_RANDOM
 	help
 	  This driver provides support for the True Random Number
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/char/hw_random/Kconfig`**
   - Added a dependency for the `HW_RANDOM_CCTRNG` configuration option on `HAS_IOMEM`. This means that the `HW_RANDOM_CCTRNG` driver will only compile if the `HAS_IOMEM` option is enabled.

### Relationships
- The modification establishes a necessary condition for the compilation of the `HW_RANDOM_CCTRNG` driver, which is part of the Arm CryptoCell support. The change addresses a compilation issue reported by the kbuild test robot, ensuring that the driver will not be included in builds where `HAS_IOMEM` is not defined, thus preventing potential build failures. This fix is linked to a previous commit that introduced the `HW_RANDOM_CCTRNG` driver.

hwrng: cctrng - Add dependency on HAS_IOMEM

The cctrng doesn't compile without HAS_IOMEM so we should depend
on it.

Reported-by: kbuild test robot <lkp@intel.com>
Fixes: a583ed310bb6 ("hwrng: cctrng - introduce Arm CryptoCell driver")
Signed-off-by: Herbert Xu <herbert@gondor.apana.org.au>
Acked-by: Hadar Gat <hadar.gat@arm.com>
Signed-off-by: Herbert Xu <herbert@gondor.apana.org.au>

Here is the root cause:
The `HW_RANDOM_CCTRNG` driver does not compile without the `HAS_IOMEM` option being enabled, which indicates that the driver relies on memory-mapped I/O operations that are not guaranteed to be available unless this dependency is explicitly stated. Without this dependency, the build system may attempt to compile the driver in environments where the necessary memory I/O support is absent, leading to compilation errors.

Here is the patch:

 	tristate "Arm CryptoCell True Random Number Generator support"
+	depends on HAS_IOMEM
 	default HW_RANDOM
 	help
